edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1: the root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions and step up hard on its downtime. - Pop Blossom runs 120/105/90s; while it is down her all-in is gone. - Budget E for her root, R for opportunities.
